subject: Renewal: support tier change + credit bridge request
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightforge.com
Date: 2027-05-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Hi Stephanie,

We’re starting renewal planning on our side for the June 30 renewal. Usage is up ~2.6x YoY and the team wants more predictable latency for peak inference windows. We9d like to discuss upgrading to the Premium Support tier with a 99.9% p95 latency SLO for our production model endpoint.

Another ask from procurement: BrightForge is asking for a one-time renewal credit to offset potential migration/testing costs as part of the tier change (they called it a "credit bridge"). Can you outline the commercial/ops pathway for both the support uplift and a short credit?

Thanks — Tom

[Attachment: BF_usage_Q1-Q1_summary.csv (csv)]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the usage summary. Short answer: we can do the Premium Support upgrade + a limited credit bridge, but there are three pieces to align:

1) SLOs & scope: Premium gives 24/7 oncall, faster incident response, and an additional p95 latency commitment we can include in the addendum. We9ll confirm modeling for your peak windows and confirm whether any infra changes are needed.

2) Commercial: the credit bridge we typically structure as a one-time credit applied on invoice contingent on a 12-month committed capacity delta (or committed monthly minimum). We can flex the structure for procurement, but we need a costed sheet.

3) Ops/onboarding: Marissa will run a short canary/onboarding plan (two-week verification) so we can validate latency before the go-live.

I9ve looped in Ben for pricing and Marissa for the ops plan. I will circulate a support addendum + pricing sheet by EOD Thursday.

— Stephanie

[Attachment: none]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Tom — pricing note from my side:

- Premium Support add-on: +18% ARR on top of your current committed spend, includes 24/7 oncall, incident SLOs and quarterly architecture reviews.
- Latency SLO extension (p95 99.9%): we9ll attach a technical SLA addendum with remediation credits capped at 1% of ARR for failures.
- Credit bridge: we can do a one-time credit equal to 2 months of your current committed billing spread across first two invoices (applied after signature). The credit is conditional on signing a 12-month capacity commitment at the agreed uplift.

I9ve put numbers into the attached sheet with scenarios (small/medium/large upsell). If you prefer, we can present a final quote to procurement next week.

[Attachment: BF-4983-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

— Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Tom — operational plan details:

- Canary + verification: Two-week canary window in your non-prod region with traffic mirroring; we9ll run a joint test plan (latency distributions, tail testing, and synthetic spikes).
- Runbook & escalation: we9ll deliver an ops runbook and a 30-day post-rollout checkpoint.
- Onboarding deliverables: onboarding checklist, dedicated CSM weekly for first 6 weeks, and two architecture review sessions.

If you sign the addendum by June 1 we can schedule the canary to finish before the renewal date and avoid any service disruption.

— Marissa
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightforge.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Thanks all — that sounds reasonable. A couple of procurement asks before we sign:

1) Can the credit be documented as a one-time invoice credit rather than an upfront rebate? Procurement prefers invoiced credits.
2) We need the SLA addendum to reference the specific endpoint names and the p95 target for production: model-prod-v3 and model-prod-v3-cached.

If you can update the addendum and send a DocuSign link before EOD Friday, procurement will expedite.

— Tom
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — support tier & a short credit request

Tom — appreciate the quick turn. Attached is the support addendum with endpoint-specific SLO language and the pricing sheet updated to show the credit as a one-time invoice credit applied to the first two invoices. I9ve also created a DocuSign packet for signature.

Next steps:
- You sign DocuSign: https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/BF-4983
- Procurement confirms PO (if required) — Ben will follow up on the final numbers.
- Marissa will schedule the canary once signed (target window: 6/7–6/21).

Attachments: Redwood_Support_Addendum_v1.pdf (pdf), BF-4983-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

— Stephanie
